nigeria_note: Nigeria parallel ranges combine three independent current-day observations dated 17 Nov and rechecked at 13:33 WAT. The published extrema preserve cross-source and location differences rather than force a single quote. All three currency ranges exceed the dispersion gate and are corroborated and documented. CBN selling benchmarks are dated 16 Nov, the latest fully published central-bank table. Aggregated from multiple independent market sources. Premium = parallel buying midpoint ÷ CBN selling rate − 1. Indicative only; not FX advice.
